symbolDescription: Keys the component handles, generated from @shortcut tags next to the implementation.

optionDescriptions.ArrowLeft: Previous page; a zoomed page scrolls horizontally first.
optionDescriptions.ArrowRight: Next page; a zoomed page scrolls horizontally first.
optionDescriptions.Ctrl+F: Focus the search field (⌘+F on macOS); Enter and Shift+Enter step through matches, Escape clears.
